repairs.quote: Jhin launches a cartridge that deals (44/69/94/119/144 + (44/51.5/59/66.5/74% Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet. The cartridge can hit a maximum of 4 times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by 35%.
